instruction: Execute only the small integrated chain in HANDOFF.md: unchanged native question -> first-module task sheet -> S2 plus independent free full-paper sources -> local Review Docling basic three-process parsing and selected CodeFormulaV2 enhancement -> bounded whole-block material evidence -> 2-3 external_evidence/model_knowledge/hybrid routes -> prepared VeriTMM input JSON. Source failures or absent external evidence do not prohibit honest model-knowledge routes. Preserve and reuse compatible completed T021 outputs; do not repeat paid calls. If T021 is in flight, let the current call finish safely and preserve it at a stage boundary before transition. Use a separate checkout; do not overwrite developing files or reset active Review worktrees. Local owns only testing and minor environment fixes; report core defects to cloud. Stop before simulation, optimization, report-PDF typesetting, broad regression, T020 suite or tuning loops. Input paper PDF parsing IS authorized.

repositories.note: External clean local runtime; reuse existing environments, cached weights and verified receipts. Review PDF/cache/weights are not bundled.

budget.requirements: First reconcile settled plus pending/held/uncertain across all existing ledgers conservatively. Keep uncertain reservations. Reuse only the original local configuration and proven D20 wrapper with ONE shared task cap and attempt counter across stages; missing enforcement means blocked without bare call. No model upgrade or new paid retrieval/parser service. 15 CNY is whole chain, not per stage and not a ledger reset.

retrieval_and_parsing.s2_retry_policy: Retry-After or increasing backoff only for unsuccessful queries. Preserve successes; exhausted queries incomplete/blocked, not zero-hit. This allowance is separate from model HTTP attempts and never applies to model retries.
retrieval_and_parsing.docling: Existing BASIC_PARALLEL3 profile: workers3, safe parser/native thread1, batches4, accelerator threads4, GPU ceiling8192MiB; resume/cache recovery retained.

retrieval_and_parsing.sources: Existing configured S2 and independent Review OpenAlex/CORE/acquisition; native XML preferred. No paid fallback, guessed URL, unapproved installation or new model downloads.
